categories.name: Smartphones
categories.description: Compare 5G handsets across camera performance, battery endurance, display smoothness, and everyday value.

categories.name: Laptops
categories.description: Ultrabooks, creator workstations, and gaming notebooks filtered by memory, storage, portability, and GPU capability.

categories.name: Headphones
categories.description: Noise-cancelling travel headphones, workout earbuds, wireless gaming headsets, and studio reference cans.

categories.name: Monitors
categories.description: Color-accurate 4K creator displays, fast 1440p gaming panels, and single-cable USB-C productivity monitors.

categories.name: Keyboards
categories.description: Hot-swappable mechanical boards, low-profile wireless travel keyboards, and quiet desk setups.

categories.name: Smartwatches
categories.description: Multi-day AMOLED fitness watches, dual-frequency GPS running trackers, and everyday LTE wearables.

products.name: CMF Phone 1 by Nothing
products.summary: Modular back casing with screw mounts, fluid 120Hz AMOLED, and clean Nothing OS under ₹16,000.
products.description: Stands out in the budget tier for clean bloat-free software, expandable storage, and interchangeable back covers with modular accessories. Skips NFC and stereo speakers to hit its aggressive price.

products.name: Nothing Phone (2a)
products.summary: Iconic transparent back with Glyph lighting, vibrant 120Hz flexible AMOLED, and balanced Dimensity 7200 Pro.
products.description: Pairs striking see-through industrial design and custom notification lights with smooth everyday performance and long battery endurance. Plastic rear frame requires a case to avoid micro-scratches.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy A35 5G
products.summary: Dependable mid-range 5G phone with IP67 water resistance, Knox security, and bright 120Hz Super AMOLED.
products.description: Targets shoppers prioritizing multi-year OS updates, bright outdoor visibility, and dependable daytime photography with OIS. Charging speeds lag behind rivals, topping out at 25W.

products.name: OnePlus Nord 4 5G
products.summary: Metal unibody mid-ranger with 5500mAh battery and strong sustained gaming performance.
products.description: Stands out under ₹30,000 for thermal stability, fast 100W wired charging, and a sturdy aluminum build. Ultrawide photography is basic, making the primary lens the clear daily choice.

products.name: OnePlus 12R
products.summary: Endurance powerhouse packing a 5500mAh battery, 4th-gen LTPO AMOLED, and Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 silicon.
products.description: Delivers multi-day battery reliability, rapid 100W charging, and flagship-tier gaming at an upper mid-range price. Omits wireless charging and telephoto zoom compared to the flagship OnePlus 12.

products.name: Xiaomi 14 Civi
products.summary: Slim 178g handset with Leica optics, quad-curved AMOLED, and dual 32MP portrait selfie cameras.
products.description: Appeals to buyers tired of heavy slab phones while keeping flagship-grade portrait focal lengths and Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 processing. Heavy gaming sessions drain the 4700mAh battery noticeably faster than larger rivals.

products.name: Google Pixel 8a
products.summary: Compact 6.1-inch camera phone with Tensor G3 intelligence, Best Take, and 7 years of OS updates.
products.description: Prioritizes industry-leading computational photography, pocket-friendly ergonomics, and long-term Google software support. Wired charging tops out at 18W, which is slower than competitors in its segment.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy S24 5G
products.summary: Featherweight 167g flagship with Galaxy AI tools, 2600-nit Dynamic AMOLED 2X, and 3x optical zoom.
products.description: One of the best compact high-end Android phones available, combining top-tier build quality, 7-year update guarantee, and dedicated telephoto zoom in a pocketable frame. Battery capacity is modest compared to Plus/Ultra models.

products.name: Google Pixel 9 Pro
products.summary: Triple-lens flagship with 16GB RAM, 5x periscope telephoto, Tensor G4, and bright 6.3-inch Super Actua panel.
products.description: Brings full pro-grade optical zoom and high-memory headroom into a manageable 6.3-inch chassis. Suited for mobile photographers who prefer manageable one-handed sizing over giant phablets.

products.name: Apple iPhone 16 Pro
products.summary: Grade 5 titanium chassis with Camera Control button, 4K120 Dolby Vision, 5x optical zoom, and A18 Pro.
products.description: Benchmark choice for mobile video creators and iOS ecosystem users needing consistent color science, pro audio capture, and unmatched chip efficiency. Base model starts with 128GB storage.

products.name: Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 15
products.summary: Practical 15.6-inch student and office notebook with 16GB RAM under ₹45,000.
products.description: Handles browsers, spreadsheets, and light photo tasks smoothly thanks to 16GB memory and a 512GB NVMe SSD. Display color gamut is basic, making it better suited to documents than color-critical media.

products.name: HP Pavilion Aero 13
products.summary: Sub-1kg commuter ultrabook with bright 16:10 matte IPS display and all-day battery.
products.description: Weighs just 990 grams without sacrificing port selection or crisp keyboard feel. Suited for commuters and students carrying a laptop daily, though integrated graphics limit 3D rendering.

products.name: ASUS Vivobook 16 OLED Creator
products.summary: Creator laptop with dedicated RTX graphics, 1TB SSD, and wide-gamut 120Hz OLED.
products.description: Tailored for 4K video editing, Lightroom batches, and motion timelines under ₹80,000. Fans ramp up audibly during long exports, and battery life drops under GPU load.

products.name: Lenovo Yoga Slim 7 Pro 14
products.summary: 32GB RAM, 1TB SSD, and factory-calibrated OLED display under ₹85,000.
products.description: Balances abundant 32GB memory for heavy video editing timelines and Docker workloads with a portable 1.45kg chassis. Lacks a discrete GPU, relying on fast unified memory and integrated graphics.

products.name: ASUS TUF Gaming A15
products.summary: High-wattage RTX gaming and 3D workstation notebook with 144Hz panel and 1TB SSD.
products.description: Excels at sustained GPU rendering, 1080p gaming, and video encoding at a sub-₹90,000 budget. Trades portability and quiet acoustics for strong cooling and upgradeable storage.

products.name: Apple MacBook Air 13 M3
products.summary: Fanless aluminum ultrabook with 18-hour battery life and silent 4K video scrubbing.
products.description: Unmatched battery longevity and silent operation for developers, writers, and mobile editors under ₹90,000. The 256GB base SSD fills fast with media projects, so external drives help.

products.name: Dell Inspiron 16 Plus
products.summary: 32GB RAM, 1TB SSD, and dedicated graphics on a spacious 16-inch anti-glare screen.
products.description: Built for creators and engineers who want both 32GB RAM and discrete GPU acceleration in a metal chassis. At just over 2kg, it works best as a desk-first machine.

products.name: LG Gram 16 Pro
products.summary: Remarkably light 1.19kg 16-inch OLED notebook with 32GB RAM and 16.5-hour battery.
products.description: Pairs big-screen workspace and 32GB memory with true featherweight travel comfort. Keyboard travel is shallower than thicker ThinkPad or workstation models.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Book4 Pro
products.summary: Anti-reflective 16-inch AMOLED touchscreen with thin aluminum build and crisp speakers.
products.description: Delivers glare-resistant OLED contrast and seamless file continuity across Galaxy devices. Memory is soldered at 16GB, limiting future upgrades for heavy 3D artists.

products.name: Apple MacBook Pro 14 M4 Pro
products.summary: Reference Mini-LED 120Hz display, 24GB unified memory, and marathon 22-hour battery.
products.description: Sustains heavy multi-stream ProRes editing, code compilation, and local builds even on battery without throttling. Premium pricing puts it well above mainstream budgets.

products.name: Sony WF-C700N Running Earbuds
products.summary: Featherlight IPX4 sweatproof earbuds with secure running fit and clean ANC.
products.description: Engineered to stay locked in during tempo runs and gym circuits while blocking steady traffic noise. The compact pocket case trades wireless charging for lower weight and price.

products.name: Nothing Ear (a)
products.summary: Punchy LDAC earbuds with IP54 dust protection, multipoint pairing, and 42.5h case battery.
products.description: Offers lively bass response, dependable IP54 workout durability, and seamless laptop-to-phone switching under ₹6,000. Call clarity drops slightly in gusty outdoor wind.

products.name: Sony WH-CH720N
products.summary: Ultra-light 192g over-ear ANC headphones built for long workdays and student commutes.
products.description: Prioritizes all-day clamping comfort and multipoint Bluetooth at an approachable price. Does not fold flat into a rigid carry case, so backpack storage takes slightly more space.

products.name: OnePlus Buds Pro 3
products.summary: Dual-driver running and commute earbuds with IP55 rating and adaptive noise control.
products.description: Pairs crisp dual dynamic-planar drivers with sweat-resistant IP55 sealing and smooth touch volume slides on the stem. Spatial audio works best on compatible Android handsets.

products.name: Sennheiser HD 560S
products.summary: Open-back wired studio reference headphones with neutral imaging and zero latency.
products.description: Designed for critical music listening, mixing, and single-player gaming in quiet rooms where natural soundstage matters most. Open-back grilles leak sound, making them unsuitable for commutes.

products.name: Logitech G Pro X 2 Lightspeed
products.summary: 50mm graphene wireless gaming headset with 50-hour battery and detachable boom mic.
products.description: Built for competitive PC and console play with ultra-low-latency 2.4GHz wireless plus Bluetooth backup. Heavier 345g metal construction favors desk sessions over travel.

products.name: Sennheiser Momentum 4 Wireless
products.summary: 60-hour battery champion with spacious 42mm transducers and balanced acoustic tuning.
products.description: Delivers class-leading battery endurance that lasts a full work week plus transatlantic flights on one charge. Noise cancellation is strong, though slightly behind Sony and Bose on deep plane rumble.

products.name: Sony WH-1000XM5
products.summary: Benchmark travel ANC over-ears with clear voice pickup and plush memory-foam pads.
products.description: Consistently silences office chatter and cabin hum while keeping weight comfortable at 250g. Earcups swivel flat rather than folding inward, requiring a slightly taller travel case.

products.name: Bose QuietComfort Ultra
products.summary: Deeply cushioned folding ANC headphones tuned for maximum cabin quietness.
products.description: Folds neatly for carry-on packing and isolates low-frequency engine drone effortlessly. Battery life tops out at 24 hours with ANC active, shorter than Sennheiser rivals.

products.name: Apple AirPods Max (USB-C)
products.summary: Anodized aluminum over-ears with lossless USB-C audio and natural transparency mode.
products.description: Stands out for build craft, breathable knit headband comfort, and lifelike pass-through audio across Apple devices. At 386g it feels heavier on neck tilts than plastic competitors.

products.name: Lenovo L24i-4A 24-inch
products.summary: Slim 100Hz 1080p IPS desk monitor suited to compact home study setups.
products.description: Brings smooth 100Hz scrolling and narrow bezels to entry-level work desks. Height adjustment is omitted on the stock stand, so a desk riser or VESA arm helps.

products.name: Xiaomi Gaming Monitor G27Qi
products.summary: Value 27-inch 1440p 180Hz Fast IPS panel for smooth high-FPS PC gaming.
products.description: Delivers sharp QHD text and crisp 180Hz motion clarity well below competing gaming monitors. Ships with a tilt-only stand and skips built-in speakers.

products.name: LG UltraGear 27GR75Q
products.summary: Ergonomic 165Hz QHD gaming display with height/pivot stand and calibrated colors.
products.description: Pairs responsive 1ms IPS overdrive with a full height-and-pivot stand out of the box. HDR peak brightness is modest, making SDR calibration the sweet spot.

products.name: BenQ GW2790QT Ergonomic QHD
products.summary: Eye-care 27-inch QHD coding monitor with 65W USB-C single-cable laptop charging.
products.description: Simplifies hybrid desk setups with 65W USB-C power delivery, daisy-chain DisplayPort, and a noise-filtering microphone. Locked to 75Hz, so it favors coding and writing over fast games.

products.name: Dell S2722QC 4K USB-C
products.summary: Crisp 27-inch 4K monitor with 65W USB-C hub and dual HDMI inputs under ₹30,000.
products.description: Brings razor-sharp 4K HiDPI text scaling and one-cable ultrabook charging into an accessible bracket. Standard 60Hz refresh rate keeps it focused on productivity and media.

products.name: LG 27UP850K 4K UHD
products.summary: 90W USB-C 4K IPS monitor with wide DCI-P3 coverage for photo and video workflows.
products.description: Powers larger 16-inch creator laptops over a single 90W USB-C cable while preserving 95% DCI-P3 color accuracy. Contrast ratio stays typical of IPS panels in dark rooms.

products.name: BenQ PD2706UA Designer 4K
products.summary: Factory-calibrated 4K monitor on a clamp ergo arm with 90W USB-C and KVM switch.
products.description: Frees up desk space with its included articulating clamp arm and speeds up dual-machine workflows via built-in KVM switching. Geared strictly for design rather than competitive esports.

products.name: Samsung Odyssey G7 32 4K
products.summary: Expansive 32-inch 4K 144Hz monitor built for immersive console and PC gaming.
products.description: Combines sharp 4K resolution with HDMI 2.1 bandwidth and 144Hz fluidity across a big 32-inch canvas. Omits USB-C laptop charging, focusing squarely on DisplayPort and HDMI rigs.

products.name: Dell UltraSharp U2723QE 4K
products.summary: 2000:1 high-contrast 4K IPS Black hub monitor with 90W USB-C and Ethernet.
products.description: Acts as a full single-cable docking station with Gigabit Ethernet, USB-A ports, and noticeably deeper blacks than standard IPS displays. Price sits higher than consumer 4K options.

products.name: ASUS ROG Swift OLED PG27AQDM
products.summary: 240Hz matte 1440p OLED monitor with instant 0.03ms pixel transitions and 1000-nit HDR.
products.description: Delivers zero-ghosting motion and true per-pixel HDR contrast for competitive shooters and dark-room cinema. Text fringing is minimal at normal viewing distances, though static UIs need pixel-care habits.

products.name: Logitech Pebble Keys 2 K380s
products.summary: Featherweight multi-device Bluetooth travel keyboard with quiet laptop-style keys.
products.description: Fits effortlessly inside tablet sleeves and switches across three devices with dedicated Easy-Switch keys. Omits backlighting and relies on replaceable coin/AAA cells rather than USB-C charging.

products.name: Royal Kludge RK61 Wireless
products.summary: Compact 65% hot-swappable mechanical starter keyboard with tri-mode wireless.
products.description: Gives first-time mechanical builders 2.4GHz, Bluetooth, and USB-C connectivity plus switch swapping under ₹3,500. ABS stock keycaps shine quickly with heavy daily typing.

products.name: Keychron C3 Pro Wired
products.summary: Gasket-mounted QMK/VIA wired TKL mechanical board for focused coding and gaming.
products.description: Brings soft gasket typing feel and full QMK key remapping into a sub-₹4,000 budget. Wired-only design avoids battery aging at the cost of desk cable routing.

products.name: Keychron K2 Pro QMK/VIA
products.summary: Versatile 75% wireless custom mechanical keyboard with QMK/VIA remapping and PBT keycaps.
products.description: Balances dedicated function keys and arrow navigation in a tight footprint with crisp pre-lubed tactile switches. Includes full VIA key remapping and multi-device Bluetooth switching.

products.name: Logitech MX Keys S
products.summary: Quiet full-size scissor productivity keyboard with smart proximity backlighting.
products.description: Whisper-quiet dished keycaps and full number pad make it ideal for shared offices and spreadsheet work. Non-mechanical switches cannot be swapped if you prefer deeper key travel.

products.name: NuPhy Air75 V2 Low-Profile
products.summary: Slim low-profile 75% mechanical travel deck with 1000Hz 2.4GHz wireless and QMK.
products.description: Packs real hot-swappable mechanical switches into a slim 598g frame that rests cleanly over laptop decks. Low-profile switch options are narrower than standard MX sockets.

products.name: Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID
products.summary: Ultra-thin 243g macOS wireless keyboard with instant Touch ID authentication.
products.description: Integrates hardware fingerprint unlock seamlessly with Apple Silicon Macs in a nearly flat profile. Touch ID does not work on Windows or Linux systems, and keys lack backlighting.

products.name: Keychron Q1 Pro Aluminum
products.summary: CNC aluminum 75% enthusiast keyboard with rotary knob, gasket mount, and wireless.
products.description: Substantial 1.7kg machined aluminum chassis eliminates desk rattle and produces a deep, muted sound signature. Built strictly to stay planted on a desk rather than travel.

products.name: ASUS ROG Azoth 75 Gaming
products.summary: Enthusiast 75% wireless gaming keyboard with OLED status panel and factory-lubed switches.
products.description: Bridges custom mechanical acoustics with ultra-low-latency 2.4GHz wireless and a customizable OLED readout. Companion software is bulkier than browser-based VIA configurators.

products.name: Logitech G915 X Lightspeed
products.summary: Full-size low-profile wireless gaming deck with aluminum top plate and media wheel.
products.description: Combines dedicated macro keys, a brushed aluminum deck, and fast Lightspeed wireless without tall keycaps. Switches are soldered rather than hot-swappable.

products.name: CMF Watch Pro 2
products.summary: Interchangeable aluminum bezel smartwatch with multi-system GPS and 11-day battery.
products.description: Delivers clean minimal watch faces, Bluetooth calling, and built-in GPS under ₹4,500. Lacks third-party app installs and tap-to-pay NFC, keeping focus on essentials.

products.name: Amazfit Bip 5 Unity
products.summary: Featherlight 25g step and sleep tracker with 11-day battery and stainless frame.
products.description: Comfortably disappears on the wrist overnight for sleep and heart-rate tracking. Relies on phone GPS for outdoor run maps rather than an onboard receiver.

products.name: Amazfit Active Edge
products.summary: 10 ATM rugged outdoor watch with dual-band GPS and 16-day endurance under ₹12,000.
products.description: Built for swimming, trail hikes, and long workouts without babying the bezel or carrying a charger weekly. Uses physical navigation buttons instead of a rotating crown.

products.name: OnePlus Watch 2R
products.summary: Dual-engine Wear OS watch achieving up to 4 days between charges with dual GPS.
products.description: Runs full Google Wear OS apps and maps while stretching battery far beyond typical single-day smartwatches. The 46mm aluminum case wears wide on slender wrists.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Watch 7 (44mm)
products.summary: 2000-nit sapphire glass Wear OS smartwatch with dual-frequency GPS and LTE option.
products.description: Offers snappy app performance, body-composition estimates, and crisp outdoor readability. Expect charging every 1.5 to 2 days when always-on display is enabled.

products.name: Google Pixel Watch 3 (45mm)
products.summary: Domed LTPO OLED smartwatch pairing smooth Wear OS UI with Fitbit readiness metrics.
products.description: Delivers fluid notifications, accurate heart-rate tracking, and morning readiness guidance in a larger 45mm frame. Domed glass benefits from care around gym equipment.

products.name: Garmin Forerunner 265
products.summary: Dedicated marathon training watch with SatIQ GPS, training load, and 13-day battery.
products.description: Built for runners and triathletes who value tactile five-button lap controls in rain, detailed recovery analytics, and multi-week reliability. Skips LTE phone calling.

products.name: Apple Watch Series 10 (46mm)
products.summary: Slim wide-angle LTPO OLED smartwatch with fast charging and comprehensive iOS integration.
products.description: Bright wide-angle display stays legible at a glance during runs, and fast charging tops up 80% in 30 minutes. Requires an iPhone and benefits from daily charging.

products.name: Apple Watch Ultra 2
products.summary: Titanium 49mm adventure watch with 3000-nit sapphire screen, 10 ATM rating, and LTE.
products.description: Adds dual-frequency precision GPS, dive depth gauges, and an action button in rugged titanium. Bulky 49mm sizing feels oversized for dress attire or sleep tracking.

products.name: Garmin Fenix 8 AMOLED (47mm)
products.summary: Flagship multisport expedition watch with offline topo maps and 16-day battery life.
products.description: Combines leakproof dive-rated buttons, built-in offline topographic mapping, and an LED flashlight for multi-day treks. Premium price targets dedicated endurance athletes.
